summary: Caches unit prices in an in-memory Map keyed by productId. Quantity stays outside the cache, so totals are always recomputed.

intent.objective: Cache unit-price computations so repeated equivalent quotes do not recompute the unit price.

assumptions.rationale: The cache key varies only by product.

preservedInvariants: Pricing behavior is unchanged for every supported input.
totalCents = unitPriceCents * quantity for every request.
